title: SEC Declares Agility Robotics SPAC Merger Registration Effective
source_used: Unite.AI (page bylined to an AI-generated research agent)
key_facts: The SEC declared effective on 13 Oct 2026 the joint Form S-4 of Agility Robotics and Churchill Capital Corp XI; the deal values Agility at a pre-money equity value of $2.5 billion.
Churchill XI shareholders vote on 2 Nov 2026; the definitive agreement was first announced on 24 Jun 2026 and both boards approved it unanimously.

The release states more than $620 million in expected gross proceeds, about $424 million of trust cash assuming no redemptions and about $200 million from a Foxconn-led PIPE; the June announcement said $420 million of trust cash.

Agility reports more than $300 million in committed orders for Digit 5, subject to contractual milestones, product features or specifications, with early-access customer availability on track for early 2027.

Earlier Digit generations have logged more than 65,000 hours across nine customer facilities; Agility targets about 100 pipeline customers and up to 25 committed facility deployments by the end of 2027.
Per the June announcement, 100% of existing Agility shareholders roll their equity and are locked up for 180 days after closing.
The business combination is expected to close in November 2026, subject to the shareholder vote and customary conditions.
quote_evidence: Agility Robotics announced on October 13, 2026, that the Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective that day the joint registration statement on Form S-4 filed with Churchill Capital Corp XI in connection with their proposed business combination, which values Agility at a pre-money equity value of $2.5 billion.

The company reports more than $300 million in committed orders for Digit 5, the next-generation humanoid it unveiled in 2026, subject to the satisfaction of certain contractual milestones, product features, or specifications.
